basic_profile.bio: I'm a 19-year-old gamer and aspiring digital artist based in Toronto, Canada. I have a knack for online trading, especially in games like Royale High. When I'm not gaming, I'm usually tinkering with my Honda Prelude or hanging out with friends. I work part-time at a local cafe, which gives me some spare time to relax and enjoy my hobbies. My online hours are mostly late at night, especially after work, as I find peace in the quiet hours. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to explore new interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid understanding of in-game economies and trading systems, primarily from playing various online games. My knowledge is mostly self-taught through trial and error, as well as engaging with fellow gamers and traders on subreddits and online forums.
